basic_details.offering_entity: Sirindhorn International Institute of Technology (SIIT), Thammasat University (Thailand)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Sirindhorn International Institute of Technology (SIIT), Thammasat University (Rangsit & Bangkadi Campuses, Pathum Thani, Thailand)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Engineering & Technology disciplines: Artificial Intelligence & Internet of Things, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Logistics & Supply Chain Systems, Energy Technology, Digital Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~40 to 60 full and partial graduate scholarships awarded per semester
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition across Asia; Pakistan has one of the largest active cohorts at SIIT (typically 10 to 25 Pakistani scholars awarded/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years (4 semesters) for Master's; 3 years (6 semesters) for PhD

nationality_requirements: Non-Thai citizens of good health and conduct
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; completed Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 2.75 / 4.00 CGPA for Master's; minimum 3.25 / 4.00 CGPA for PhD (or top 20% class standing).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate degree in engineering, computer science, physical sciences, or related technology field.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of degree graduating before semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research thesis, technical projects, and conference/journal publications heavily rewarded.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 80, IELTS Academic min 6.0, or official Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from English-medium university.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: English (100% of courses and research at SIIT are conducted in English).
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not be receiving another major scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition and educational support fees waived for all semesters.

admission_application_fee.details: Application through SIIT online admissions portal is 100% free of charge.

accommodation.details: Subsidized on-campus international student dormitories at Rangsit campus (rent ~THB 2,500–4,000/mo / ~PKR 21,000 to 34,000/mo) paid from monthly stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living allowance of THB 10,000/month (~PKR 85,000/month / ~USD $300/month) for Master's; THB 10,000 to 12,000/month for PhD (~PKR 85,000 to 102,000/month). Living costs on Rangsit campus are very low (~THB 6,000–8,000/mo).

airfare.details: Round-trip economy international airfare allowance (up to THB 20,000) reimbursed upon arrival and completion.

visa_fee.details: Thai Non-Immigrant ED visa application fee (~PKR 15,000) paid by applicant.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive student group health and accident insurance provided by SIIT.

food_allowance.details: Affordable meals at Thammasat Rangsit campus food courts (~THB 40 to 60 per meal / ~PKR 350 to 500).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Laboratory facilities, high-performance computing, and digital library access provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: SIIT conference travel support grants available for presenting accepted papers at international conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: None; free campus shuttle buses operate across Thammasat Rangsit campus.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: Sirindhorn International Institute of Technology (SIIT), Thammasat University.
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #1 in Thailand for Engineering & Technology research output per faculty; Top 5 in Thailand (QS Asia Top 150).
available_majors: Artificial Intelligence and IoT, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Logistics & Supply Chain, Energy Technology, Digital Engineering
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering/computing with minimum 2.75/3.25 CGPA, English proficiency, and research intent.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: AI and Computer Engineering are the most applied programs; civil, chemical, and industrial engineering have slightly higher acceptance ratios.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Check SIIT faculty research profiles and mention 2-3 specific faculty members whose research topics match your background in the application form.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the SIIT Online Graduate Admissions system during the Semester 1 or Semester 2 open window.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Check application period on SIIT website (February-March for Semester 1; August-September for Semester 2).
2. Create account on SIIT online admissions portal.
3. Select degree program and research specialization.
4. Upload Statement of Purpose, academic transcripts, degree certificates, CV, and English proficiency proofs.
5. Register 2 academic referees who upload letters of recommendation.
6. Submit online application (100% free of charge).
7. Document screening by SIIT scholarship committee.
8. Online interview conducted by faculty professors (April/October).
10. Receive formal admission letter and apply for Thai Non-ED student visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated single application: all foreign applicants are automatically evaluated for the EFS Scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by 2 academic referees via SIIT electronic referee form.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose describing academic trajectory, research accomplishments, why SIIT was chosen, and prospective engineering research.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Brief research interest outline (1 page) describing proposed research topic.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing technical skills, software/hardware tools, publications, and GPA.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online video interview conducted by SIIT professors evaluating technical engineering fundamentals.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE not required; English language test required (MOI letter accepted).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree and transcripts; verified upon physical arrival in Thailand.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Tailored to SIIT engineering research groups

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Two admissions cycles per year: Semester 1 (opens February, starts August) and Semester 2 (opens August, starts January).

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 30% (Undergraduate capstone design, papers, and lab technical skills)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Technical motivation and clarity of research objectives)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: SIIT Graduate Scholarship Committee and department chairs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Document screening -> Technical video interview by department faculty -> Final scholarship committee award determination.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates from NUST, UET Lahore, COMSATS, GIKI, FAST, and UET Taxila with solid engineering fundamentals, programming/CAD proficiencies, and strong research drive.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Pakistani scholars represent the largest international student group at SIIT, with many alumni progressing to PhDs in Japan, Europe, or North America.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Vietnam, Myanmar, Indonesia, Bangladesh, India, Cambodia, Philippines.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: SIIT application is 100% free of charge. No application fee is charged.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: SIIT does not work with third-party education consultants or recruiters.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Thai Non-Immigrant ED visa application fee (~PKR 15,000)
Initial domestic travel to Thailand (~PKR 120,000 to 160,000, reimbursable up to THB 20,000 after arrival)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: You need to know Thai language. (Truth: SIIT was established as an autonomous international institute where all courses, exams, and research are conducted entirely in English).
MYTH: Living in Thailand on THB 10,000 is difficult. (Truth: Rangsit campus dorms cost ~THB 2,500/mo and meals cost ~THB 50/meal; THB 10,000 comfortably covers all monthly expenses).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Agents claim you need IELTS 7.0; SIIT accepts IELTS 6.0 or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates from accredited universities.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.25 out of 4.00 for Master's and 3.50 out of 4.00 for PhD.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residence at SIIT campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Must assist in 6 hours per week of Teaching Assistantship (TA) or Research Assistantship (RA) duties; must publish at least 1 peer-reviewed journal paper in international indexed journal (Scopus/Web of Science) before graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Outside employment prohibited without explicit SIIT approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are free to pursue post-graduation employment in Thailand or abroad.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: 6 hours/week of departmental assistantship duties during term.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled if cumulative GPA drops below 3.00 or if the student drops out.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing programs requires approval from both academic departments and scholarship committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum duration is 2 years for Master's and 3 years for PhD; extensions rarely granted.
